# Psalm 65 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

## 65:1 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** For-the-choirmaster. A-psalm of-David. A-song.
- **LOGOS:** For the choirmaster. A psalm of David. A song.
- **PNEUMA:** For the music director. A song. A psalm of David.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 65:6 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** With-awesome-deeds in-righteousness You-answer-us, O-God of-our-salvation, the-trust of-all the-ends of-the-earth and-the-farthest sea;
- **LOGOS:** By awesome deeds You answer us with righteousness, O God of our salvation, the hope of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest seas;
- **PNEUMA:** You faithfully answer our prayers with awesome deeds, O God our savior. You are the hope of everyone on earth, even those who sail on distant seas.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **LOGOS:** who stills the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, the tumult of the peoples;
- **PNEUMA:** You quieted the raging oceans with their pounding waves and silenced the shouting of the nations.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 65:11 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Its-furrows You-drench abundantly; You-settle its-ridges; with-showers You-soften-it; its-growth You-bless.
- **LOGOS:** You water its furrows abundantly, settling its ridges, softening it with showers, and blessing its growth.
- **PNEUMA:** You drench the plowed ground with rain, melting the clods and leveling the ridges. You soften the earth with showers and bless its abundant crops.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
